additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411363-DC/Si-D/PL-[dwszYn] Converter Error CRM:00798001951
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon,
Thanks for analysis and information from your side.
"The power module is not available. It reports various errors from time to time: -
for fast shutdown: 0, 2
for other errors: 7, 52"
First of all, Error 7,52 are non-critical error and Repair is not needed.
Fast Shutdown: 0 - idle; 1 - successful; 2 - not performed
In order to address the issue,
I am seeking information about the charger. What is power of the Charger?
As per commissioning document, It is mentioned as 180 kW. (i.e. 9 Converters)
And While in SCB, We could see the Charger is having 11 Converters.
Could you pls confirm if you are trying to do power upgrade?
If so, We recommend to subscribe to
8EM5905-0AA00-2AA8
.
Looking forward to hear back from you.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
